methodology.note: All major free SEO tools (Moz Domain Analysis, Ahrefs Website Authority Checker, SEMrush Free Tools, SEO Review Tools, SerpForge, Rhino Rank, Backlinko, OpenPageRank) require JavaScript rendering or API authentication. critical_limitation: DA/DR/Spam Score numerical values could NOT be obtained without paid API access to Moz, Ahrefs, or SEMrush. All free web-based checker tools render results via JavaScript which cannot be scraped. To get exact DA/DR numbers, you need: (1) Moz API key ($99/mo), (2) Ahrefs API ($99/mo), or (3) SEMrush API ($129/mo). The proxy signals used here (domain age, Google indexing, DNS configuration, CommonCrawl, nameserver analysis) provide a reasonable estimate of relative authority.
